subtitles.en:
Ugh, I just agreed to work this weekend...
all because I'm terrified of saying "no"!
subtitles.zh: 呃，我剛剛又答應這週末要加班了……全是因為我真的怕死說「不」了！

subtitles.en:
Hey, don't panic! Next time... just try the
three-step "Soft No" formula.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，別慌！下次……只要試試「溫和拒絕」三步驟公式就行了。

subtitles.en:
Oh, please teach me! How does it actually
work?
subtitles.zh: 噢，快教教我！這到底該怎麼做？

subtitles.en:
Well, step one—show some appreciation:
"Thanks so much for thinking of me!"
subtitles.zh: 嗯，第一步——先表達感謝：「太感謝你想到我了！」

subtitles.en:
Then step two, state your limit: "Honestly...
I'm completely swamped this week."
subtitles.zh: 接著第二步，表明你的底線：「老實說……我這週真的忙得不可開交。」

subtitles.en: Hmm, and what's the final step?

Offer an alternative—something like, "Could
we revisit this next Tuesday instead?"
subtitles.zh: 提供替代方案——像是：「我們改到下週二再來討論這件事，好嗎？」

subtitles.en:
Wow... that's so polite, professional, and
with zero guilt!
subtitles.zh: 哇……這招既有禮貌又專業，而且完全不會有罪惡感耶！

subtitles.en:
Exactly! So... what's the hardest thing for
you to turn down? Tell us in the comments
below!
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！那麼……對你來說最難開口拒絕的事情是什麼呢？
快在下方留言告訴我們吧！
